assertions.title: Cloud fallback conditional on OpenRouter key

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack config reset --yes` then `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force`
steps.expected: No cloud fallback in stack/litellm config without key
steps.observed: Generated configs had only local tiers; no `cloud_fallback`, `premium`, or `openrouter` entries.

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack config set openrouter-key sk-or-g4-test-key` then `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force`
steps.expected: Cloud fallback and premium OpenRouter entries appear
steps.observed: Stack gained `cloud_fallback` section; litellm config gained `premium` entries with `openrouter/...` models and `api_key: os.environ/OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force --add gemma3-12b --remove longctx`
steps.expected: Additional model added as tier and longctx removed

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force --add not-a-real-model`
steps.expected: Invalid model errors with catalog suggestion

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force --add gemma3-27b`
steps.observed: Command warned: `Adding 'gemma3-27b' exceeds memory budget (65.3 GB > 51.2 GB)`.

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults` when stack exists
steps.observed: Command failed (exit 1): stack already exists and instructs to use `--force`.
Command succeeded (exit 0) and regenerated stack/litellm files.

assertions.title: Missing local models detected with pull suggestion

steps.action: Run `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack config set model-dir /tmp/.../models-empty` then `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force`
steps.expected: If models are missing, output lists missing model IDs and suggests `mlx-stack pull`
steps.observed: Output listed all missing models and included explicit `Run mlx-stack pull` guidance.

steps.action: Create local model directories for all tier model IDs under configured model-dir, then rerun `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run mlx-stack init --accept-defaults --force`
steps.expected: No missing-model warning when all required models are local
steps.observed: Second init output had no `Missing local models` section and no pull suggestion.

assertions.title: OpenRouter key enables cloud fallback end-to-end

steps.expected: Cloud fallback + premium OpenRouter model entries added
steps.observed: Cloud fallback appeared in stack and premium OpenRouter entries appeared in litellm config.
Cloud fallback and premium OpenRouter entries were removed.

frictions.description: Assigned MLX_STACK_HOME already contained prior stack/model artifacts, so overwrite-sensitive checks needed explicit `config reset --yes` and repeated `init --force` setup to normalize state.
frictions.resolution: Reset config and reran init phases in deterministic order; captured isolated evidence for each phase.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions via CLI. All 5 passed: cloud fallback gating, add/remove customization (including invalid-model and over-budget behaviors), overwrite protection, missing-model pull guidance, and end-to-end OpenRouter-key reset flow.
